text:
leo-zhang: Heads-up, finance — we just got a dispute from issuer for txn 0xB2c4a: 'duplicate processing' on acct redwood-inc-901. Payment method: Venmo wallet. Details?
amy-finance: I'm on it. Payments bot showed two settle events. Trying to reconcile settlement vs gateway.
payments-bot: Alert: risk=MED-HIGH txn=0xB2c4a dup_score=0.71 vendor=Venmo
nate-risk: Can we get gateway webhook dump + merchant-settlement CSV + raw processor trace? Also need ledger entries for pre-auth/capture flows.
olivia-support: Customer attached their Venmo feed screenshot, says only one $120 charge. Link: https://redwood-secure/901/venmo-claim.png
leo-zhang: Attaching quick dump: settle_id=SET-2025-901, gateway_trace_id=GT-77a9, auths=[auth1@2025-12-05T09:15:12Z, auth2@2025-12-05T09:15:15Z] amount=120.00
amy-finance: auth2 shows reversal flag from processor in webhook with reason_code=RF_DUPLICATE_RETRY, but settlement CSV includes settle row only once. Could be client retry that didn't reach settlement.
nate-risk: For dispute response we need: 1) merchant confirmation of single capture 2) customer screenshot 3) gateway logs 4) acquirer settlement confirmation 5) IP/device UA.
leo-zhang: Adding device info: ip=54.223.12.44 ua='Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11)' fingerprint=fp_9a3d
amy-finance: I'll assemble the evidence bundle and upload to CASE-2025-901. If acquirer still disputes, we need to file representment within 30 days with supporting docs.
payments-bot: Evidence uploaded CASE-2025-901 status=PENDING_RESPOND deadline=2026-01-04T09:15:12Z
olivia-support: Notifying customer: "We've escalated to payments ops and submitted evidence to the bank. We'll follow up within 5 business days."
leo-zhang: Quick note: flag merchant for potential retry-bug. If we see >3 duplicate auths within 5 minutes for same customer, auto-suspend merchant checkout until manual review.
nate-risk: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up ticket with eng-payments to add rate-limiting and dedupe heuristics.
amy-finance: Thanks all. Monitoring for any related chargebacks. :eyes:
